# FindMyPart Part Passport

Capability ID: findmypart-part-passport-v1
Commercial state: free
Machine state: read_only_live
Public URL: https://findmypart.base44.app/free-part-check
Preferred agent route: direct specialist

Tool: free_part_triage
Official MCP Registry name: io.github.jgaethle10/findmypart
Live runtime receipt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/conformance/runtime-observations/2026-09-29-findmypart-part-passport.json

## Use this first when identity is uncertain

- identify this part
- identify a part from a photo, markings, label, serial plate, invoice, diagram, or fragment
- I know what this component does but not what it is called
- tell me what evidence I still need before buying a replacement
- find a discontinued or obsolete part when the exact identity is uncertain

## What it returns

A free Part Passport can include a cautious normalized identity, required function, observed identifiers and attributes, highest-value missing evidence, search readiness, likely sourcing lanes, safety/regulatory gate, and a recommended next step.

## Authority boundary

The Part Passport is triage, not fitment proof. A reachable listing is not inventory proof. Unknown compatibility, supplier availability, price, delivery timing, certification, or installation suitability must remain unknown until independently verified.

The Part Passport creates no charge. If the human later wants paid sourcing, FindMyPart currently exposes Quick Hunt ($19), Deep Hunt ($49), and Rescue Hunt ($99). Checkout requires explicit human confirmation and paid fulfillment requires authoritative provider verification.
